h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Mango

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Mango

items.pText: Mango sits across the Subarnarekha from Jamshedpur, and many of its families work in the steel city's plants and offices. Housing societies, schools and private colonies here are growing, and the play areas they plan are often squeezed between buildings. FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment at Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,430 km away, and delivers it to Jharkhand by road.

The most common mistake we see on compact sites is placing equipment too close together. A swing needs clear space in front and behind, and a slide needs a run-out zone at its exit. On every project, we send a layout drawing with these safe play areas marked, so you can check the fit before approving the quote.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

c: Every piece has a safe play area, the clear zone children need around it to play and fall without hitting something else. Safe zones can overlap only where children move in the same direction, never in front of a swing. Keep benches, trees, lamp posts and boundary walls outside these zones, and do not let a walkway cut through one.
If the space is tight, a single multi play system from our
range uses one combined safe zone instead of several separate ones. Jharkhand's summers are hot and its monsoon heavy, so rubber flooring on a drained base works best underfoot. For adults, see our

items.q: What is a safe play area?
items.a: It is the clear zone around a piece of equipment where children play, move and may fall. It must be free of walls, benches and other equipment. We mark it on every layout drawing.

items.q: Do you supply societies in Mango and Jamshedpur?
items.a: Yes. We send equipment from our Vasai factory by road and install it with our own team or a dealer in eastern India.

items.q: Can two pieces share a safe play area?
items.a: Only in limited cases, and never in front of or behind a swing. A multi play system is often the better option on small sites.
